full.q: Can we outsource our entire accounting function?
full.a: Yes. We provide an end-to-end service, from source documents and payroll to reporting and regulatory requests.

transition.q: How do we transition from our current accountant?
transition.a: We begin with a rapid audit, create a handover plan, and coordinate the transfer of records and documents.

privacy.a: We document obligations in the contract, control access, and use secure document exchange channels.

aboutPage.title: We make complex finances clear
aboutPage.intro: FinKeep is a team of accountants, tax consultants, and analysts. We help business owners see the real picture and make confident decisions.
aboutPage.heading: Professional responsibility without bureaucracy
aboutPage.p1: We started with a simple idea: high-quality accounting support should give business owners not only accurate reports, but also peace of mind.
aboutPage.p2: That is why we study the business model, identify risks early, and remain available when decisions need to be made quickly. Every client knows their team personally.
aboutPage.quote: “We measure quality not by the number of documents prepared, but by the client’s confidence in their numbers.”

general.title: 1. General provisions
general.text: This policy defines how FinKeep processes and protects personal data submitted by website users. By using the website and submitting forms, the user confirms that they have read this policy.

data.title: 2. Data we collect
data.text: We may process your name, phone number, email address, company name, and information voluntarily included in your message.

purpose.title: 3. Processing purposes
purpose.text: Data is used to respond to requests, prepare proposals, provide services, and improve the website. We do not disclose data to third parties except where required by law.

rights.title: 4. Your rights
rights.text: You may request information about processing, correct your data, or withdraw consent by emailing privacy@finkeep.ru.
